_doc: Where fork-tests.yml's Linux jobs run: this repository's own fleet of self-hosted runners, or GitHub-hosted.
The one place for every fact about this repository and its fleet: .github/scripts/fork-fleet.py has none.
Read by `route` (fork-tests.yml), `sweep` (fork-fleet.yml), `capacity` (a step of each routed job) and `gate`
(each fleet runner's job-started hook runs an installed copy of the script with an installed copy of this file).
The setting is the repository variable named in `variable`: auto (unset too), fleet or github. Runbook:

pools._doc: The owner's PC: one-job (JIT) registrations, so a runner is online only while the PC waits for a job.
pools.name: pc

pools._doc: A sandboxed always-on runner VM (one runner, memory check before each job): fleet mode queues here.
